# Step - as

`as` · `as_` · category: [Labels and paths](../../traversal/step_reference.md#labels-and-paths)

Labels the current step so select(), where() and path() can refer back to it.

## Forms

```text
as(arg1: any)
as(arg1: array)
as(arg1: any, arg2: any)
as(arg1, …, arg10)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).as("a").out("knows").as("b").select("a", "b").by("name").next()   // #{"a": "marko", "b": "josh"}
```
